headline: Indian benchmark indices snap four-day loss on value buying and strong Asian market cues

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Value buying lifted Indian markets, snapping a four-session losing streak for benchmark indices.
Gains on Wall Street and strong performance in Asian markets, including Kospi soaring on Q3 GDP beat, boosted investor sentiment.
Rupee weakened below 95.18 against the US dollar amid elevated global oil prices.
Investors are closely watching global cues, including upcoming US Fed rate decisions and international market movements.
whatHappening: Sensex settled 500 points higher and Nifty closed above 22,750 as buying resumed.
Asian stocks gained following Wall Street's positive close led by tech market highlights.
NBFCs in India are curbing fresh loans in rural markets due to elevated repayment risks from a weak monsoon.
State Bank of India launched its CyRIS centre to strengthen cybersecurity capabilities.
summary: Indian stock markets snapped a four-day losing streak as value buying and positive cues from Asian peers lifted the benchmark Sensex and Nifty higher. High crude oil prices and a weaker Rupee continue to pose headwinds for domestic markets. Key sector movers included banking, pharmaceutical, and consumer goods stocks.
